summary: Iteration 10 fully verified. Backend pytest test_marina_iteration10.py: 29/29 PASS (sequential). All 6 new features working end-to-end. (1) Category filter /conveniencia: 5 chips render (cat-filter-all/Bebidas/Sorvetes/Açaí/Outros); tapping filters product cards correctly (All=8, Bebidas=3 seed-cerveja/refri/agua, Sorvetes=1 seed-picole, Açaí=1 seed-acai, Outros=3 seed-gelo/protetor/salgadinho). (2) Staff signup: POST /api/users with is_staff=true creates staff (verified TEST_Funcionario Iter10 88888888888 and seed 77777777777 login 77777/0077 returns is_staff=true); GET /api/users includes staff and excludes admins; admin-clientes shows Carlos Funcionario card with 'Funcionário' badge, 'Acesso ao painel de funcionário' text, and NO boat section; novo-cliente modal has role-cliente/role-funcionario tabs (via new-client-button testID). (3) admin-status has dark background, 'EMERGÊNCIA' red tag next to boat Netuno, status-emergency-banner '3 emergências abertas' visible. (4) Consumo report GET /api/reports/consumo?month=YYYY-MM: aggregates convenience_total (non-cancelled orders) + reboque_total (billed emergencies) per client; grand_total sums correctly; João=R$ 4901,00 (all reboques after billing), Maria=R$ 20,00; past month 2020-01 returns empty; defaults to current month. admin-relatorio: month-label 'Ago/2026', grand-total 'R$ 4921,00', month-prev/next navigate correctly, consumo-{cpf} expandable rows. (5) Emergency alert propagation: /admin shows admin-emergency-banner when open emergencies exist (tap navigates to admin-solicitacoes); /admin-status shows status-emergency-banner + status-emergency-{id} tags per boat with open emergency. (6) Reboque: GET /api/reboque/quote table verified for 7 combos (24/8=1560, 25/5=1200, 30/10=2700, 35/5=1800, 40/10=3750, 50/5=2500, 22/3=1200); POST /api/reboque uses client boat length (João/Netuno 22ft → base 1200, 3 additional NM × 120 = 1560); appears in Meus acionamentos as 'Reboque • Em atendimento • Estimado: R$ 1560,00'. Frontend /emergencia tab-socorro/tab-reboque work; reboque-boat-select shows Netuno, comprimento hint '22 pés', reboque-distance '8' triggers reboque-quote card with base R$ 1200,00 + adicional (3 MN × R$ 120,00) R$ 360,00 = reboque-total 'R$ 1560,00'. (7) Billing: PATCH /api/emergencies/{id}/bill sets billed_amount/billed_at (verified 1600.5 persisted); 404 on unknown id; admin-solicitacoes aba Emergências renders reboque-bill-input-{id} + reboque-bill-{id}; after billing shows 'Lançado na conta: R$ 1600,50' green pill. (8) Regression: login (admin 00000/0000, cliente 11111/1111, staff 55555/0055, funcionario 77777/0077), /requests full lifecycle (subida 17:30 unlimited), /convenience/orders create/list/status, /emergencies create/list/resolve, /authorizations create/checkin/cancel, /products with 4 categories — all OK. Deprecated packages detected: none. SafeAreaView usage OK (react-native-safe-area-context).

issues: Money formatter uses toFixed(2).replace('.', ',') without pt-BR thousands separator (shows 'R$ 1560,00' / 'R$ 4921,00' instead of 'R$ 1.560,00' / 'R$ 4.921,00'). Cosmetic only, values are correct.

action_items: OPTIONAL cosmetic: centralize a pt-BR money() helper (e.g., new Intl.NumberFormat('pt-BR', { style: 'currency', currency: 'BRL' })) instead of the ad-hoc `R$ ${v.toFixed(2).replace('.', ',')}` used in emergencia.tsx, conveniencia.tsx, admin-relatorio.tsx and admin-solicitacoes.tsx — currently thousands separator missing. Not blocking.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py:887-914 reboque_quote table is correct and boundary-inclusive (<=25 first bucket, <=35 second, else 2500/250). Included_nm=5 constant. Distance <5 gives additional_nm=0 (max()) — correct.

server.py:922-926 _boat_length_for iterates user['boats']; falls back to None if boat not found. Note: if user picks a non-existent boat_name the endpoint silently uses top bucket (2500) — acceptable UX (hint on frontend already warns 'usando maior faixa').
server.py:957-985 create_reboque persists spread of quote fields (boat_length, distance_nm, base_fee, per_nm, additional_nm/fee, estimated_total, included_nm) — makes admin billing UI self-contained.
server.py:999-1008 bill_emergency uses matched_count for 404 detection and rounds amount to 2 decimals — correct.

server.py:1023-1079 consumo_report filters by ISO prefix regex on created_at / billed_at — safe because backend always writes UTC ISO. Bucket lambda avoids KeyError. grand_total rounded, clients sorted by total desc — clean.
server.py:565-573 list_users excludes is_admin=true (correct for admin-clientes UI). Legacy string boats normalized to objects in the response.
server.py:576-596 create_client accepts is_staff and enforces 11-digit CPF + 409 on duplicate — correct.
emergencia.tsx:32-41 reboqueQuote mirrors backend table exactly (verified parity: 22ft/8NM shows 1560 on both). Good defensive fallback for missing length (top bucket).
emergencia.tsx:87-93 quote memo re-computes on selectedLength/distNum change — no unnecessary renders.
conveniencia.tsx:158-208 category grouping filters PRODUCT_CATEGORIES then products.some(...) → hides empty groups when a specific chip is chosen. Verified: 'Sorvetes' shows only 1 product.
admin-status: dark theme with EMERGÊNCIA tag + banner. Confirmed via screenshot.

admin-solicitacoes.tsx billing flow uses reboque-bill-input-{id}/reboque-bill-{id} testIDs and shows 'Lançado na conta: R$ x,xx' green pill after PATCH; caixa-summary is a Pressable that navigates to /admin-relatorio — good UX.

success_rate.backend: 100% (29/29 pytest sequential; 28/29 in xdist parallel — 1 known ordering artifact between billing/consumo, not a product bug)
